title: I’m Addicted to the Cozy Slime Game I Made with Claude Fable 5! Check it out.
author: burakhasekix
selftext:
Before Claude Fable 5 was shut down, inspired by my girlfriend, I started making a cozy game where you run a slime shop in a dystopian post-apocalyptic universe. The game is incredibly addictive and a great time-killer. You can try it out yourself using the link below! (Currently, it’s only playable on PC).

Do you think I should keep developing the game? It will feature a progressing storyline and more slime mechanics in the future.

What are your suggestions?

  
[https://myslimeshop.vercel.app/](https://myslimeshop.vercel.app/)

comments.author: forrestwear
comments.body:
the premise is original and unique atleast. 'dystopian post-apocalyptic universe' is a bottleneck you'll have to address sooner or later. cozy games live and die by their art. having fable 5 (which is disabled now) make the entire game from scratch makes expanding hard because you need consistency across the entire world/story/art. opus 4.8 will have to do heavier lifting than you would've originally thought and that's what you have to expand on.

i'd suggest using opus to build something smaller and finding some consistent work flow that you can use to help build on. once you have something unique to you and your tools, polish it, and then think to yourself ''is this still fun'' after working on it for a week. no? hit the drawing board. yes? invest money and build, build, build. 

Good luck
